definition: Automatic writing is writing produced without the writer’s full conscious participation, so that words or sentences seem to be formed by themselves. In historical psychology, it was treated as a complex kind of automatic movement seen both in some nervous disorders and in otherwise healthy people, with no settled explanation for how it occurs.
